aboutGame.title: What is The Escapists 3?
paragraphs: The Escapists 3 is a fully 3D prison escape sandbox from Team17, announced in October 2026 and scheduled to launch in 2027 on PC and consoles. You live a full inmate schedule of roll call, meals, work shifts, and lights out while quietly assembling the tools, disguises, and routes needed to break out.

The sequel ships with five distinctive prisons, more than 120 items and weapons to loot or craft, and an XP progression system that carries your unlocked skills from one facility to the next. Escape solo or bring a crew of up to four players in local split-screen and online co-op.

modules.name: The Escapists 3 Beginner Guide
modules.description: Start your first week behind bars the right way with the core systems every new inmate needs: routine, stats, heat, crafting, and escape planning.

highlights.detail: Walk the full perimeter once so you know where the walls, fences, and guard posts sit.
Learn the daily schedule so roll call, meals, and work shifts never catch you off guard.
Talk to at least two inmates, because favors and trades are how you get rare items.
Train Strength, Speed, and Intellect early, since they gate which escapes are possible.
Keep guard heat low by attending roll call and staying out of restricted rooms.
Find your cell stash spot before you dig, or contraband gets confiscated in a shakedown.

modules.name: The Escapists 3 Prisons and Escape Routes
modules.description: Compare the escape routes available across the five confirmed prisons and pick the approach that fits your playstyle, from quiet tunnels to loud yard breaks.

highlights.label: S
highlights.detail: Digging tunnels from your cell: the classic route, but dirt and noise raise heat fast.

highlights.label: A
highlights.detail: Disguises and forged guard uniforms: slow to assemble, safest once complete.

highlights.label: B
highlights.detail: Vertical routes through rooftops, vents, and climbing paths only 3D prisons allow.

highlights.label: C
highlights.detail: Brute-force yard breaks and vehicle escapes: loud, fast, and easy to punish.

modules.name: The Escapists 3 Crafting Recipes and Items
modules.description: Build a working reference for the 120+ items and weapons you can loot or craft, and learn which combinations carry an escape from planning to breakout.

highlights.label: Plan
highlights.detail: Recon first, then work backward from the exit to the components you actually need.

highlights.label: Digging
highlights.detail: Sheets, spoons, and pickaxes form the backbone of every tunnel route.

highlights.label: Disguise
highlights.detail: Guard uniforms and forged paperwork get you through checkpoints and staff doors.

highlights.label: Decoy
highlights.detail: Noise makers and cut power lines pull guards away from your exit window.

highlights.label: Stash
highlights.detail: Hide components in your desk or a co-op partner's cell before inspections.

modules.name: The Escapists 3 Multiplayer and Co-op Guide
modules.description: Plan a coordinated breakout with friends: local split-screen for two players, online co-op for up to four, and the role splits that keep a crew efficient.

highlights.label: Solo
highlights.detail: Run a single-inmate escape first to learn routines and test routes safely.

highlights.label: Local
highlights.detail: Local split-screen co-op supports two players sharing one screen.

highlights.label: Online
highlights.detail: Online co-op supports two to four players with crossplay enabled.

highlights.label: Roles
highlights.detail: Split scouting, crafting, and lookout duty so the whole crew stays busy.

highlights.label: Xbox
highlights.detail: Console online play requires a Game Pass Essential, Premium, or Ultimate plan.

modules.name: The Escapists 3 Skills and Progression Guide
modules.description: Understand the confirmed XP system and how unlocked skills carry between prisons, then build an inmate that survives a change of facility.

highlights.detail: Earn XP by playing: jobs, training, and successful escapes all feed progression.
Unlock skills that match your escape style instead of spreading points thin.
Avoid over-specializing, because your skills carry over between all five prisons.
Train Strength for digging, Speed for patrol windows, and Intellect for crafting.
Rebuild your loadout whenever you move to a facility with new routines.

modules.name: The Escapists 3 Tips and Tricks
modules.description: Practical advice for staying under suspicion, managing heat, stashing contraband, and recovering when an escape plan falls apart.

highlights.label: Routine
highlights.detail: Memorize roll call and patrol times before you attempt anything risky.

highlights.label: Heat
highlights.detail: Missing roll call or entering restricted rooms spikes suspicion fast.

highlights.label: Stash
highlights.detail: Never leave contraband in the open, or one inspection erases weeks of work.

highlights.label: Favors
highlights.detail: Trading with inmates is often faster and safer than stealing what you need.

highlights.label: Backup
highlights.detail: Keep a second escape route ready in case your first plan collapses.

highlights.label: Patience
highlights.detail: Wait for the window your recon found instead of forcing a break early.

faq.title: The Escapists 3 FAQ
faq.description: Straight answers about The Escapists 3 release plans, prisons, crafting, co-op, and progression.

items.question: When does The Escapists 3 come out?
items.answer: The Escapists 3 has a confirmed 2027 release window for PC and consoles after its October 2026 announcement. The exact launch day is published on the official store page once Team17 sets it.

items.question: How many prisons are in The Escapists 3?
items.answer: The Escapists 3 ships with five distinctive prisons. Each facility has its own routines, characters, secrets, and escape routes, so your plan has to be rebuilt every time you move.

items.question: Does The Escapists 3 have co-op?
items.answer: Yes. The Escapists 3 supports solo play, two-player local split-screen co-op, and online co-op for up to four players with crossplay enabled.

items.question: How many items and weapons can you craft in The Escapists 3?
items.answer: Team17 has confirmed more than 120 items and weapons to loot or craft in The Escapists 3, covering digging tools, disguises, decoys, and improvised weapons.

items.question: What platforms is The Escapists 3 on?
items.answer: The Escapists 3 is coming to PC via Steam, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S in 2027.

items.question: Do skills carry between prisons in The Escapists 3?
items.answer: Yes. XP and unlocked skills in The Escapists 3 carry from one prison to the next, which is why a flexible inmate build beats an over-specialized one.
